invoke_tool: invoke a test tool on an LLVM IR file and return normalized stdout output
scrub_body: scrub whitespace, expand tabs, and strip trailing whitespace from assembly body text
build_function_body_dictionary: build a dictionary of scrubbed function bodies from raw tool output for each check prefix
add_ir_checks: add FileCheck-compatible IR check lines with variable genericization to output lines
add_analyze_checks: add FileCheck-compatible analysis output check lines with variable genericization to output lines
